events_summary.content: Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

events_summary.speaker: CATHERINE
events_summary.content: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: Stop.
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!
Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: She did.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.
Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

events_summary.speaker: CATHERINE
events_summary.content: You want me? As a guest?
Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: As a scullery maid.
Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

events_summary.speaker: CATHERINE
events_summary.content: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?
Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.
Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.
Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight.

events_summary.speaker: CATHERINE
events_summary.content: You humiliate me.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
